items.desc_en: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family’s financial ties to the chipmaker.

items.desc_zh: 微软表示，这次中断不是由网络安全事件引起的，但迄今为止解决这些问题的努力基本上不成功。
